area: Path analyzer: app service groups (endpoint_snapshots.py, vendor_endpoints.py, m365_endpoints.py, app_services.py, zia_path_modules.py, bulk_test.py, Advanced settings card)
title: App service groups match out of the box: bundled dated excerpts of six providers' published lists (match only, expiring), GoTo's JSON list fetchable on its own switch, and Zscaler's own groups unknown with the exact reason

checks.what: Each provider's group (Microsoft 365, Zoom, Webex, RingCentral, GoTo, Talkdesk) matches a published destination from the bundled excerpt with nothing fetched, naming the excerpt, its date and age
An excerpt never yields no match; an expired excerpt (over 180 days) settles nothing
GoTo's JSON list: only address ranges taken; malformed JSON, private, over-broad or malformed ranges, too deep, too many values or over 1 MB refuse the whole list
No outbound request from matching, status or page load; GoTo is fetched only when switched on and Fetch now is clicked, from its one declared host, no redirect followed
Zscaler's own app service groups stay unknown, and the reason (no SDK call lists app service groups or their members) is checked against the installed SDK

findings.title: App service groups never matched out of the box: Webex, RingCentral, GoTo and Talkdesk only after a hand import, Microsoft 365 and Zoom only after an opt-in fetch
findings.fix: endpoint_snapshots.py (bundled dated excerpts, match only), app_services.criterion/current, vendor_endpoints status

findings.title: GoTo publishes a machine-readable list but could only be imported by hand
findings.fix: vendor_endpoints PROVIDERS goto fetch, parse_json; Advanced settings switch advVendGotoOn; SECURITY.md and secure_by_design outbound line
